component.name: PrintCraft
component.summary: Read, organize, combine, split and secure PDFs

description.p: This is a community package of PrintCraft, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the PrintCraft project. It repackages the official upstream Linux release build unmodified.
PrintCraft is an open-source, native PDF workbench written in Rust that follows the Adobe Acrobat workflow. Documents never leave your machine.

ul.li: Fast, sharp rendering with continuous, two-up and Read mode layouts
Find, select and copy text; bookmarks and thumbnails for long documents
Rotate, delete, insert and reorder pages
Open protected documents; comments, forms, layers and attachments
An opt-in MCP server for AI agents: printcraft-cli mcp

description.p: The headless command runner and MCP server is included: flatpak run --command=printcraft-cli ai.storyteller.printcraft --help

Permissions: this package uses the same sandbox as upstream's own Flatpak manifest: display (Wayland, with X11 as a fallback), the GPU device, and the Pictures folder. Files anywhere else are opened and saved through the system file chooser. No network access is granted.

ul.li: Let agents on the host reach the --control automation server: flatpak override --user --share=network ai.storyteller.printcraft
Open files by path anywhere in your home folder (command line, Open Recent): flatpak override --user --filesystem=home ai.storyteller.printcraft
